name: haroom_plugins
description: haroom Claude Code plugins - ddaro, prism, triad, mangchi, galmuri

plugins.name: ddaro
plugins.description: Worktree-based parallel workflow with dev-cycle orchestration (0.4.0). 6-tier worktree classification + /ddaro:adopt + cwd-safe destructive commands + size-based merge review + crash-recoverable context logs. 0.4.0 adds: /ddaro:commit --verify (verify.json + CLAUDE.md fallback), /ddaro:merge CI polling + state machine + hard-capped fix loop + CI_STUCK detection + idempotency + confirm gate + sync-main content-diff preview, opt-in evidence_check hook, plus the queued branch_naming / cross_worktree_check / branch_worktree_match guards. Korean triggers: 따로, 병렬로.

plugins.name: prism
plugins.description: Multi-angle code review - 5 parallel agents discover, singleton verifier cross-checks. Agreement auto-confirms.

plugins.name: triad
plugins.description: 3-perspective deliberation on one document or code file - LLM clarity / architectural longevity / end-user comprehension - parallel subagents until consensus.

plugins.name: mangchi
plugins.description: Iterative cross-model code refinement - Claude patches, Codex CLI reviews one axis per round with verification loop, until the code converges.

plugins.name: galmuri
plugins.description: Distill reusable, project-agnostic techniques (hooks, rules, guards, structural patterns) from a project into portable technique cards in a knowledge repo - so the know-how survives without the project. Korean trigger: 갈무리.
